player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''BRay''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]] list on DeckTech in July 2000.

starting.card: Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe

description: This is a classical old style manipulator with SYC start. I used it at DragonCon & Origins opens, with the only loss to Clint Hays.
cards: Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
notes: Total 60 as published (no section headers). The strategy says 'Start with Resistance in most cases'; Resistance is the Effect (no Defensive Shields in 2000).
Played at two events per the post: the 2000 DragonCon Open (29 June – 2 July) and the 2000 Origins Open (13–16 July); event set to Origins, the later one; no finish stated.

Posted 'DS control room' dested Death Star: Docking Control Room 327 (the strategy uses it to deploy the docking bays; judgment call); 'DS docking bay' Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Tat docking bay' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'endor docking bay' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'cantina' Tatooine: Cantina (Dark side of each).

Posted 'Dark Lord' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mara x2' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Maras saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Miiyoom Onith' M'iiyoom Onith; 'you coward' Come Here You Big Coward; 'Twilek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'elis' Elis Helrot; 'P1/HT/S1/MH' the bounty hunter pilot-in-ship cards.
player_note: The post (17 July 2000) says: 'I used it at DragonCon & Origins opens, with the only loss to Clint Hays.' The author added the Death Star Tractor Beam, another Scanning Crew and Dengar In Punishing One after DragonCon, so the posted list may differ from the DragonCon version ([[2000 DragonCon Open]], won by [[Clint Hays]]).
